discussion.body:
User posted Snapfrog as the final Act 0 boss design. Status write is rev 18.
Name lock: Snapfrog. Hybrid of snapping turtle and frog. Sheet features: monster-like head, armored spiky algae shell, powerful webbed legs, spiked mace tail. Jump and swim kit.
Earlier squat blue-gray description and FEAT-052-act0-boss-concept / sketch plates are superseded by this sheet.
